Why Wages Rise

F. A. Harper

Discover the truth about wages and labor unions in this enlightening book. Through F.A. Harper's insightful analysis, readers will learn that wages are driven by the worker's own efforts, not by external forces like labor unions. Harper also explores the crucial role of skill-building in boosting wages and advancing in one's career.
